status_summary: Public Law 119-20 (S.J. Res. 31), approved 2025-06-20, disapproved EPA's September 2024 rule that had required certain reclassified sources to keep meeting major source standards, and it has no force or effect. EPA then published a final rule on 2026-01-02 (91 FR 58), effective the same day, that removes the 2024 amendments and restores the text of the 2020 reclassification rule. The Federal Register document gives 2026-01-02 as the effective date and sets 2026-03-03 as the deadline for petitions for review in the D.C. Circuit; no petition for review of this rule was found.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-20 (S.J. Res. 31) became law, disapproving EPA's 2024 rule on reclassification of major sources as area sources.
EPA published and made effective a rule removing the 2024 amendments and restoring the 2020 reclassification text.

title: Restore the 2020 policy letting major sources reclassify to area source status
uncertainties: Re-check on 2026-10-19: the Federal Register page confirms the 2026-01-02 effective date and a 2026-03-03 petition deadline; searches and a tracker found no petition for review, stay or reconsideration request aimed at the 2026 rule. A ruling in No. 21-1024 could affect the 2020 text that the 2026 rule restored. Two D.C.
